scope: Q7 v1.01 lens discovery/capability, cached focus data, AF policy consumption, command admission and completion. Original-code evidence and bounded synthetic replay for future AF research.

discovery.initialization: LensService_LensInitializeSequence 0x8011097c powers/configures the path and invokes LLC startup 0x80111448. On its success it sets communications-state bit 0x01, reads primary data via 0x80113eac and runs single regular communication via 0x80115f50. In this branch it ORs bit 0x04 if primary returns 1 and bit 0x08 if primary returns 1 and regular result is 1 or 7.
discovery.bootstrap: 0x80111448 invokes LLC commands 1,2,4,5 before map reads. Command (0,1,0,1) returns the 8-byte function-group bitmap. For each group marked 1, (0,1,group,0) returns the 32-byte operation bitmap. The routine expands both bitmaps LSB first, one u8 per bit, and sets map-read-OK 0x80c2a2d9 to 1 only after successful map discovery in this path.

maps.getter: LensService_GetLensFunctionMapEnableOperation 0x8010fdf0 returns the map byte only when u8(map_version)==1, otherwise 0.
maps.initialization_scope: LensService_LensCommunicationControlValueInitialize 0x8010f598 clears the map and other communication state. The synthetic success replay starts with initialized memory and models LLC replies, lower link settings and response bytes.

discovery.af_capability: LensDataServer_ExGetAfEnable 0x80114b08 returns false unless communications-state & 0x08 is nonzero and map 1/group 2/operation 4 is nonzero. 0x8042e278 delegates to it. DataHelper_IsRestrictionFocusMode 0x80436a60 and UpdateCameraSettings 0x80444348 also call the same getter.
discovery.transport_admission: LensService_LensCommunication 0x80111214 checks the per-operation map only when map-read-OK byte equals 1. A zero map value then returns 7 before lower transport. Native mode-0 search is tuple (0,1,2,4), the same operation checked by AF capability. The native transport gate itself does not repeat the communications-state bit 0x08 test.
discovery.primary_spec_choice: ComGetLensPrimarySpecData 0x80113b60 queries map 1/group 8/op 7 to choose (0,1,8,7) extended or (0,1,8,2) legacy. On extended return 1 it sets 0x80c2a73e. It copies 0x78 bytes into the supplied buffer. Replayed command selection models transport response and does not assert support of the fallback command for all simulated maps.

cached_fields.producer_notes: Primary communication initializes status bytes, records success status 1 for primary buffers and clears failed buffers. 0x80115c8c alternates ordinary VDRC receive buffers at 0x80c2a848 and 0x80c2a948, copies cached data and sets the VDRC status byte to 1 on result 1. 0x80114700 refreshes the first five bytes, then can dispatch pending synchronized search.

fields.name: current location
fields.encoding: BE 32-bit word ORed into initialized caller output

cached_fields.return_contract: The observed getters copy/decode data even if the associated returned validity/status byte is zero. The return and out-parameter are separate. No-stub replay includes validity/status values 0, 1 and 7.

af_policy.scan_boundary: AfMain_Thread_sub 0x80383dfc reads the minimum location at 0x80383e9c into 0x80395924, over-infinite limit at 0x80383ea8 into 0x803959f4, and lens ID at 0x80383eb4 into a stack halfword then 0x803959ea. On a zero reported limit this branch uses 0x938 for lens ID 1 or 0xa6e for lens ID 2 and sets the local validity value to 1. The physical units and hard stops are unresolved.
af_policy.speed_boundary: CAutoFocusService_GetMaxSpeedSteps 0x80378e98 returns 0 if cached max-speed status is zero or decoded speed is zero. Otherwise the observed binary32 path converts the unsigned value by multiplying with the stored 0x3b888889 constant and then 100.0, truncates to unsigned and returns the low 16 bits. Seven no-stub cases exercise this conversion. CalcMinBackPosition selects an ID 1/2 table at 0x803a26dc or the reported max-speed field before its further comparisons and caps. Hardware units remain unresolved.
af_policy.calculation: The earlier portability replay isolates the mathematical estimator at 0x8037d704. The surrounding scan is coupled to cached position, speed, lens-dependent correction and motion status. 0x8041167c copies VDRC motion to eMotorStatus, and increments an AF polling counter when its mode word equals 1.
af_policy.drive_limit: The transient actuator-limit mode byte at 0x80c2a2e2 is a different policy from the cached travel limits and capability bits. The mode-2 setter 0x8011357c skips queue send and returns 8 only when this byte equals 1; it still copies request arguments first. Initialization and the observed eco-mode paths clear this byte. Its complete enable lifecycle is unresolved.
af_policy.work_scope: Future AF changes would need to retain attachment/capability admission, status and endian semantics, lens-specific limits and command synchronization. The current work establishes these boundaries and does not change the algorithm or firmware.

commands.request: Existing LensDriveControl 0x8037eb78 and capture dispatcher 0x8042e040 carry the shared request. Search/location/stop use messages 6/7/8. Mode 3 arms a deferred search for separate VD-sync processing.
commands.acknowledge: Mode-2 setter 0x8011357c stores request at 0x80c2aa50/+4, writes pending byte 0x80c2aa49=1 and posts message 7 when admitted by actuator-limit check. Worker 0x801161a8 stores the lower communication result at 0x80c2aa57 and clears pending. Native setter replay with a modeled scheduler returns the injected result when acknowledged at waits 0,1,100, and status 6 at wait 101 including the same-poll late clear. Delay arguments are observed as 1 per call; no physical timing is inferred.
commands.distinction: Queue acknowledgement proves worker response handling for this setter. It does not establish that the optical group reached a target or even that motion began.

completion.arming: CaptureLensControlService_ExecuteFocusControl 0x8042e040 clears start count and motion-check state. The request byte at +1 equal to 1 and request mode !=1 arm state 1. If that byte !=1 the branch immediately emits completion notification 0x10060032 rather than waiting for the live-view motion check.
completion.callback: CaptureLensControlService_CallBackLiveView 0x8042e5ac uses the output status byte from 0x80112514. State 1 transitions to state 2 if motion==1, current start poll count >=6, or disable-start-wait byte is nonzero. State 1 increments the start poll count on each callback and does not emit completion on the transition callback. State 2 remains while motion!=0. At motion==0 it clears the state, emits command 0x6003f and completion notification 0x10060032.
completion.binding: 0x8042dcd0 binds completion slot 0x80c6aaf4 via 0x803786e8 to 0x803786b4. Original sender 0x8042ddc8 invokes the slot, and recipient 0x803786b4 sets 0x8039592c=1 only for notification 0x10060032. The AF worker has explicit readers of that flag.
completion.separate_waits: 0x8042e4c4 repeats while the cached status byte is nonzero without a bound in that routine. CAF sequence-exit wait 0x803787e4 can request stop, wake the sleeping sequence and wait for its separate exit-complete event with wait argument 0xffffffff. Neither bound is equivalent to the mode-2 command acknowledgement counter.
completion.replay_scope: Completion replay seeds the original state and synthetic telemetry and invokes the actual live-view callback, status getter, completion sender and AF completion recipient. Focus settings and the other command recipient are modeled. The replay does not run a capture scheduler or lens.

reproduction.requirements: SHA-pinned expanded analysis ELF and angr/VEX. Output path must not exist.

replay.scope: Concrete original instructions for map decode/capability, big-endian cached data, command acknowledgement and motion completion.

capability: 0x80110c50 lower transport only for original command admission
completion: 0x8040a008 capture command recipient; record arguments only

evidence.role: Initialization, primary read and conditional readiness bit
Function bitmap and per-group operation bitmap reads, original map pointers and LSB expansion
AF capability takes attachment state and map 1/group 2/op 4; real transport operation gate
Primary-spec variant and writes into supplied buffer; main primary cache owner
Primary and VDRC field access and exact source status
AF scan reads the physical-model inputs and uses lens ID when cached limit is zero
Zero travel-limit defaults for lens IDs 1 and 2; live maximum-speed conversion and table fallback
Drive-limit skip, queued location acknowledgement, timeout and worker reply
Capture arm, callback state transitions and distinct stop/completion commands
Original completion slot and AF flag, separate CAF wait

trace_limitations: Extents end at the next distinct sidecar address, not a typed ELF function size.
Linear MIPS32 word scan; edges are instruction candidates, not proof of reachability.
Delay slots are included in extents. Register-indirect targets are unresolved.
A jump is recorded as a transfer, not automatically a function call.
limitations: Firmware command arguments and cache layout are observed. Wire signaling, motor identity, physical position units and travel or speed accuracy were not measured.
The replay injects lens link replies, scheduler outcomes and live-view telemetry. It cannot establish real-world attach behavior, time bounds or completion success for a specific lens.

The data-flow includes normal/still and short AF telemetry paths, representative AF scan consumers and the modeled live-view completion branch. Other mode branches or specific lens policy tables remain to be traced.
No firmware patch, camera operation or lens EEPROM access was performed.
next_offline_checks: Replay readiness-bit setting under failed and successful primary/regular replies, including map retry/clear and stale cache windows.
Trace lens-specific fallback branches for zero travel limit and replay safe synthetic position windows through the first search decision.
Chain modeled lens status changes to the bounded scan loop and compare command sequencing, dismount/stop and timeout behavior under fault injection.
